expectedBehavior: Every app display, dashboard, detail, planning, data-health, release-gate, and analysis path that reasons about Airframe work state should read from canonical state or an explicitly documented canonical projection. File-system Markdown should be treated as import/export/projection material, not as authoritative runtime state.
notes: Acceptance Criteria: 1. Inventory AgileCockpit, AICockpit, and AirframeCore read paths used for display, dashboard summaries, planning views, detail panels, data-health, release gates, and analysis. 2. Identify every path that reads Markdown files, workspace config active pointers, generated docs, or file-system artifacts as authoritative work state after canonical state is available. 3. Update affected display and analysis paths to read canonical state or a clearly documented canonical projection. 4. Preserve Markdown import/export behavior without treating Markdown as runtime source of truth. 5. Add regression coverage for at least the current Epic/Sprint pointer mismatch class and any other stale file-state paths found. 6. Document any intentional remaining file reads with rationale and ownership boundary.

Acceptance Criteria Update: 7. Epic closeout can recover from note-style or requirement-derived acceptance criteria by generating canonical Epic acceptance-criteria records before close eligibility is evaluated. 8. Epics with truly missing acceptance criteria remain blocked by default unless a future human-only close-with-exception path records an explicit justification and audit trail.

Implementation Evidence: AgileCockpit dashboardData now treats backend/canonical records as authoritative when canonical state exists; Markdown artifacts may still supply detail text but no longer add or override display records. AICockpit create/propose default ownership now resolves through canonical project context when canonical state exists. Intentional remaining file reads are limited to Markdown import, Markdown export/projection, generated projection synchronization, and status detail text for human drill-down.

Verification: swift test --package-path AirframeCore; swift test --package-path AICockpit; xcodebuild test -project AgileCockpit/AgileCockpit.xcodeproj -scheme AgileCockpit -destination 'platform=macOS'; aicockpit state diagnostics --backend canonical.
Created after resolving the EP-022 Epic Criteria tab inconsistency. Do not close EP-022 until this broader source-of-truth audit is resolved or explicitly deferred.
observedBehavior: Recent AgileCockpit behavior showed dashboard-style views and detail or criteria views disagreeing about the current Epic because some display and analysis paths still read stale file or configuration-derived state instead of canonical state. The EP-022 active-Epic mismatch suggests this may be a broader migration gap after moving from file-based documentation analysis to canonical state.
reproductionSteps: Create or observe canonical state where the canonical project and canonical work records disagree with stale file or configuration-derived state.
Open AgileCockpit dashboard, planning tabs, criteria tabs, data-health, and status/detail views.
Compare displayed current Epic/Sprint/work relationships and analysis diagnostics.
Observe any path that still reports file/config-derived state instead of canonical state.

workItem.title: Display and analysis paths may still read file-based state instead of canonical state
